newBrowserCases: Six workflows on both projects: map/focus/text retention, saved slots/preferences, all-room canvas/audio persistence and guarded library access, obsolete room loading, sound/menu-paused timing, and saved-list/file-read retry.
recoveryRegression: Context loss retains usable card controls and room travel; explicit renderer retry preserves the accepted garden move. Forced GPU draw failure retains the alias and saving.
lifecycle: One Pixi application and one audio context through normal room/view and journey changes. Explicit renderer retry or browser reload may recreate the renderer.
resourceLimits: Latest-destination texture installation with reference-counted leases; obsolete network requests may finish before their results are released.
renderBudgets: Framebuffer approximately 2 million pixels; density at most 1.5; 30 FPS cap in portrait or behind surfaces, 45 in unobscured landscape; hidden/reduced-motion ticker paused. These are configured caps, not real-device measurements.
traceRecording: Retain-on-failure action/network/DOM/source records; continuous filmstrip disabled; explicit and failure screenshots retained.
evidence: Ten reviewed desktop/phone screenshots copied from the final passing gate; i2-check.log retains command output.
scope: All locations share the full-viewport world and kit. Direct room instruments and final portrait compositions remain in I3–I5.
deviceLimits: Phone emulation is not real-device performance/audio testing. Zoom/accessibility review and Firefox/WebKit remain in I6/release review.
dependenciesAndArt: No new dependencies or raster assets; existing show-inspired sprites and paintings reused with code-native SVG/CSS surfaces.
